newsitem.title: USA: US Stockpile sells 140 tonnes tin at $2.82/lb.
newsitem.headline: US Stockpile sells 140 tonnes tin at $2.82/lb.

text.p: The U.S. Defense Logistics Agency said it sold 140 tonnes of stockpile tin at its daily offering Friday to two companies at a unit price of 2.82 per lb.
The DLA sold 100 tonnes of tin to RMT of New York, N.Y. and 40 tonnes to Ney Smelting of Brooklyn, N.Y.
The DLA also said it will not hold a pricing or sale of tin on Monday, Sept. 2, in observance of Labor Day. Tin sales will resume Tuesday, Sept. 3, it said.
